"""
LRU Cache implementation with type hints, docstrings, and extensive unit tests.
"""

from typing import Optional, Any, Tuple, List
import unittest


class LRUCache:
    """
    A Least Recently Used (LRU) cache implementation.
    
    This cache evicts the least recently used items when the cache is full.
    It uses a doubly-linked list for O(1) access and a dictionary for O(1) lookup.
    
    Attributes:
        capacity (int): The maximum number of items the cache can hold.
        _cache (dict): Dictionary mapping keys to (value, node) tuples.
        _head (Node): Sentinel head node of the doubly-linked list.
        _tail (Node): Sentinel tail node of the doubly-linked list.
    """
    
    class Node:
        """
        Internal node class for the doubly-linked list.
        
        Attributes:
            key (Any): The key associated with this node.
            value (Any): The value associated with this node.
            prev (Optional[Node]): Pointer to the previous node.
            next (Optional[Node]): Pointer to the next node.
